## Tech workers

Take "externalities as design criteria" into your actual backlog: propose one red-team exercise or anti-KPI for a product you touch. And if your industry itself generates externalities you can no longer square with your faith, know that vocation realignment is a legitimate act of repentance — one your church should support without penalty or disruption (see the church-leader lane). Then run the Isotēs Checklist on something you ship: does it create reciprocal abundance (users' surplus meeting others' needs, and returning), temporal contingency (today's giver can be tomorrow's receiver), and universal sufficiency — or permanent winners and losers, extracting from and manufacturing scarcity out of what could be abundant?
